content.title: Contact support about a submission
content.description: An author opens the contact page to find support hours and phone contact details, and is instructed to quote a `SUB-` reference number and route back through the submissions area when asking for help about a manuscript submission.
content.summary: Contact support using a submission reference.
content.value: Reduces support friction by giving authors the right contact details and reference context.
criteria: `/contact` is headed `Contact & support` and shows the support hours `Monday–Friday, 9:00am–5:00pm.` and phone number `(555) 020-0200`.
`/contact` tells the reader to quote their `SUB-` reference number and links to `/my-submissions`.
